goal: GAP SWEEP (wave 5b): every listed depth_target is currently not_simulated/config_only in the shipped console. Build each one on a REAL backend (Nano + offline) and lift its capability level to full or limited. 'Out of Vyomi's scope', 'separate product', 'single-account' or 'not modeled' are NOT acceptable reasons: model it in the shared core (Python core/*_core.py, vendored to wasm), wire it through the native wire, enforce behaviour (not stored config), and make the console section live. Only leave a target not_simulated if it needs something physically impossible in a local simulator (real external hardware, real money, a real third-party service) — and then write that concrete reason. config_only targets must become enforced (the setting changes observable behaviour). Update core/capabilities, tests/conformance, ui-spec mapping and smoke where relevant.
note: WAVE 5b gap sweep (orchestrator). Approved by the user: finish all the gaps with real backends.

depth_targets.title: Private service connection
depth_targets.current_reason: Allocating ranges for Google-managed services and the private-services-access connection to them is not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Network firewall policies (hierarchical / regional policy resources)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi models the classic per-network VPC firewall rule, not the newer Network Firewall Policy resource (its own rule evaluation order and org/folder attachment).

depth_targets.title: VPC Flow Logs (Subnets / VLAN attachments / Cloud VPN tunnels)
depth_targets.current_reason: No VPC Flow Logs export. Offline with netsim enforcement on, real per-flow counters exist and core/netsim/flowlogs.py renders GCP flow records from them, but nothing writes them to Cloud Logging yet.
depth_targets.hint: telemetry: emit real metrics/logs from the simulated engine (wave-6 Prometheus/OTel are the offline sinks once landed; until then derive real series from actual API activity in the core) — never synthetic random data

depth_targets.title: Internal ranges
depth_targets.current_reason: The Internal Range Allocator (planning/reserving CIDR blocks across an org before they're assigned to subnets) is not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Shared VPC (host/service project attachment)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi's Compute core is single-project; cross-project host/service VPC sharing and its IAM delegation are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Serverless VPC Access connectors
depth_targets.current_reason: Connectors bridge serverless products (Cloud Run/Functions) into a VPC; Vyomi does not run a serverless data plane that would use one.

depth_targets.title: Packet mirroring
depth_targets.current_reason: Mirroring clones live packets to a collector; Vyomi has no data plane producing real packets to mirror.
